rules.description: No hardcoded credentials or secrets in source code.
Avoid range(len()) iteration; iterate directly over collections.
Every public function must have corresponding unit tests.

nfrs.performance: Review summary generated within 2s for diffs < 500 lines
nfrs.reliability: Invalid input returns 400 with error message, never crashes
nfrs.observability: Duration and grounding ratio logged per review
nfrs.security: No secrets echoed back in review output
